newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saint-Louis unit eyes Polish development.
newsitem.headline: Saint-Louis unit eyes Polish development.

text.p: Generale Sucriere, the sugar unit of Groupe Saint-Louis, plans to develop in Poland but without its British partner Tate and Lyle Plc, its chairman said in a newspaper interview.
"We have projects in Poland, without Tate & Lyle. But I cannot say more just now," Alain Meulnart told industry weekly Le Betteravier Francais.
Generale Sucriere and Tate & Lyle hold stakes in sugar companies in Hungary, Slovakia and the Czech Republic through their Eastern Sugar venture.
The privatisation of the Polish sugar industry has attracted interest from several foreign sugar groups.
French company Eridania Beghin-Say has said that its Ceresucre unit was interested in buying 17 sugar refineries in Poland located in the eastern region of Silesia.
